rootCause: The three B62 Node entry points imported repositoryRoot from the general SceneSpec module. That module imports Ajv, even though B62 root discovery does not use schema validation. A clean clone without node_modules therefore failed before preflight logic began.

authorizedCorrection.change: Derive repositoryRoot from each entry point import.meta.url using only Node built-ins; bind this C2 document in tool hashes and ancestry checks.
forbidden: installing or symlinking node_modules in the rehearsal clone
changing assets, frames, render settings, thresholds, gates, attacks or verdicts
reusing the failed temporary clone as official evidence
